GN.name: Impôt sur les revenus de capitaux mobiliers, dividends to resident individuals (15 %)
GN.statute: CGI 2021 (loi L/2021/0032) art. 170, 189 (LF 2025 L/2024/0235/CNT checked: art. 170-195 not amended; LF 2022-2024 not held)
GN.doc: art. 189: income distributed to individuals domiciled in Guinea is withheld at 15 % of the amount distributed.

GN.name: Impôt sur les revenus de capitaux mobiliers, interest (15 %)
GN.statute: CGI 2021 art. 190 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
GN.doc: art. 190: interest from fixed-income investments paid to resident individuals is withheld at 15 %, bond lots included; interest on savings accounts and term deposits of more than three months with banks is outside the withholding (art. 190 II).
unsupported: interest on savings accounts and bank term deposits over three months is not withheld (art. 190 II): the household's interest is taken to be other interest

GN.name: Impôt sur les plus-values immobilières non professionnelles (15 % final levy)
GN.statute: CGI 2021 art. 162-163 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
GN.doc: art. 162: gain = sale price less taxes and deed costs borne by the seller, less the acquisition price; art. 163: final proportional levy of 15 % of the taxable gain.
unsupported: exemptions and the acquisition value by comparison when no deed exists (art. 162 IV)

GN.name: Versement forfaitaire sur les salaires (6 %)
GN.statute: CGI 2021 art. 201 (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
GN.doc: art. 201: individuals and companies employing staff in Guinea pay 6 % of the total wages, allowances and emoluments actually paid.
unsupported: taxe d'apprentissage 2 % of wages (art. 210), due only by employers not subject to the 1,5 % vocational-training contribution (art. 206 3°): which applies is set outside the CGI

GN.name: Contribution foncière unique, owner-occupied housing (5 % of annual rental value)
GN.statute: CGI 2021 art. 264-265 1° (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
GN.doc: art. 264: base = real annual rental value (for housing, the rent of a similar property; for commercial use 10 % of 70 % of cost); art. 265: 5 % for housing occupied by the owner or not let, 10 % for professional premises occupied by the owner, 15 % for let property.
unsupported: 10 % for professional premises occupied by the owner (art. 265 2°)

GN.name: Contribution foncière unique, let property (15 % of annual rental value)
GN.doc: art. 265 3°: let property 15 % of the real annual rental value (other buildings of the household are taken as let).

GN.name: Droit d'enregistrement, mutation à titre onéreux d'immeubles (5 %)
GN.statute: CGI 2021 art. 534 II, tariff I (LF 2025 checked; LF 2022-2024 not held)
GN.doc: art. 534 II tariff I: sale of immovables 5 % of the value stated in the deed; 2 % for buildings bought for demolition and rebuilding, land bought to build housing, and industrial premises.

GN.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (donations, successions)
GN.why: the tariff row for gifts and successions (direct line / spouses 'droit progressif', non-relatives 20 % / 30 %) is garbled in the two-column extraction; the progressive scale was not located
